Jumping

Power jumpAlways on. Jump three times in a row, each right as you land, and a ring fills around your ball. Then your next jump is extra tall.

Building

 How many

Keyboard

A key can only do one thing. Esc, - and + are always settings and zoom.

Keys in menus and the build menu

Used in every menu, pop-up and the build menu. They can be the same keys you roll and jump with. 1–9 buy straight away in the build menu, and Esc always closes.

Building with the keyboard: open the build menu with its key, change the tab with the tab keys (or left and right), pick with up and down (or 1–9) and buy with Select. Then roll to where it should go and use "Place it", or "Cancel placing".

Menus with the keyboard: every menu and pop-up works with the arrows (or the keys you move with), Enter or Space picks what is lit, Esc goes back. The keys above open the chat, the big map, how to play and the pause menu.

Bots

 bots play with you
Bots are all different: racers (some great, some not), explorers, builders who put up little towers, and some who just hang out. Ask them for things in the chat ("Can you open the gate?", "Follow me", "I need dirt") and sometimes one will help.
The public world is only real people. Bots can play in your private world or offline.

    Secret codes

    In a game, double-tap your coins, type a code, then OK.

    Cheats end when you leave the game (in a public world, when the map changes). Then you keep the money you have, but never more than before. In a private game set to No cheats, the cheats do nothing.

    Before you play

    BALLPIT.PARTY is for adults (18 and older).

    The game has open text chat with strangers. Messages are not checked by people, so you may see things you do not like. Family friendly mode (on by default, in Settings) hides rude words, but other players can still write anything.

    Never share personal details like your address, school, phone number or passwords. You can mute anyone from Friends.

    By tapping the button below you confirm you are 18 or older and agree to play at your own risk.
